title: Show every GB in decimal units: disk-full toasts, free-space logs and model sizes still print binary GB
description: Decision 2026-09-15 (Fabio): decimal GB everywhere, matching RunPod, Hugging Face and macOS. Binary today: _fmtGb in routes/downloadManager.js (both disk-full toasts, free-space log lines) and js/utils/formatBytes.js (model sizes). Detail: brief.md.
